name: Instant RLUSD demo transfer without owner approval
description: Verifies the global transfer form settles an internal RLUSD demo payment using a recipient's registered wallet email or cell phone number.
steps: Enter a registered recipient wallet email or cell phone number and destination country
expected: The payment shows Completed (Demo), the shop balance decreases, the recipient account identified by email or phone increases and no owner approval is requested.

name: Dashboard weekly and monthly performance
covers: sales revenue and gross profit totals
description: Verifies each dashboard performance period returns a date-scoped report.
expected: Each period displays its date range, revenue, stock costs, gross profit, margin and recorded sales count.

name: Supplier payment without email
description: Verifies supplier payments complete in demo mode without supplier email details.
steps: Add a supplier using a name and country only
Choose the supplier in Accounts Payable
Pay from the demo shop account
expected: The supplier payment completes immediately and records both sides without an email address or approval queue.

name: Store RLUSD demo deposit and on-chain account status
description: Verifies a connected store XRPL address displays its validated RLUSD trust-line balance and deposit destination.
expected: The store demo account shows Available and its balance. A demo deposit debits the funding pool and credits the store. On-chain balance and trust-line status remain separate.
